elements.name: gift.offerCard
elements.note: Phase 4h: `PaywallMetrics.offPillTop` moves 270 -> 278 so the OFF pill sits under the "33%" digits' baseline instead of across them (owner: "the OFF under 33% needs to be moved down a bit"). The card's own frame does not move: the pill is one of five rows inside a fixed-size card, and the card is a single combined accessibility element, so the pill has no frame of its own to record here. What guards the move is `BrandPlacementTests` (at most a tenth of the digits covered, at most 6 pt of air, at least 8 pt to the "+3 day trial" pill) and the gift-open RMSE.
